chain.hop_rule: First receipt is hop 1. Process selected first-hop receipts FIFO by time/block/hash. At each unlabelled address select its earliest later outgoing transaction of the same exact asset; if that transaction has multiple outputs follow its largest output (ties: destination then event id). Reserve that outgoing transaction once across FIFO paths; do not substitute its smaller outputs, split or proportionally haircut lots. Stop at the first labelled class, unresolved ordering/coverage, repeated address, or hop 5. This is a temporal path heuristic, not a balance-aware FIFO taint accounting system: earlier unrelated balances, mixing and ownership are unknown. Original USD is a seed-weight only; no downstream USD attribution.
notes: First-hop only. Alternative program and chain views describe the same gross dollars; never add them.
Shared-program rows split equally across distinct tags, preserving total; this is an accounting convention.

notes: Paths are temporal same-asset observations under the documented heuristic, not uniquely attributed funds.
Successful HTTP raw responses and failed observations are gzip-cached with request URLs, retrieval times and hashes.
All selected first-hop receipt edges are attempted FIFO; each downstream outgoing transaction is reserved once. Unknown history/order and supported-route gaps are explicit.
No Etherscan, keys, transfers, swaps, asset substitutions, contract execution or inferred owners. Host request spacing is 1.25 seconds.
CEX/mixer hop distribution is conditional on labels and prefix coverage; unresolved paths are censored, never zero hops.
